title: Add tokenize(text)
body:
Add `src/tokenize.js` with a named export `tokenize(text)` that returns the words of `text` as an array of lowercase strings, in order.

Rules:
- A word is a maximal run of Unicode letters, digits and apostrophes (`'`).
- Apostrophes at the start or end of a word are stripped; a word that is then empty is dropped.
- Everything else (spaces, punctuation, symbols) separates words.

Examples:
- `tokenize("Don't stop, believing!")` → `["don't", "stop", "believing"]`
- `tokenize("Hello, HELLO hello")` → `["hello", "hello", "hello"]`
- `tokenize("'quoted' words")` → `["quoted", "words"]`
- `tokenize("café 42")` → `["café", "42"]`
- `tokenize("")` and `tokenize("  ,,, ")` → `[]`

Add tests for these in `test/`.

title: Add wordFreq(text, options)
body:
Add `src/freq.js` with a named export `wordFreq(text, { top } = {})`. It uses `tokenize` from `src/tokenize.js` and returns `[word, count]` pairs.

Rules:
- Sorted by count, highest first; equal counts sorted by word, alphabetically (`a` before `b`).
- `top` (optional positive integer) keeps only the first `top` pairs.
- No words → `[]`.

Examples:
- `wordFreq("b a b c a b")` → `[["b", 3], ["a", 2], ["c", 1]]`
- `wordFreq("z y x")` → `[["x", 1], ["y", 1], ["z", 1]]`
- `wordFreq("b a b c a b", { top: 2 })` → `[["b", 3], ["a", 2]]`

Add tests in `test/`.

title: Add slugify(text)
body:
Add `src/slugify.js` with a named export `slugify(text)` that turns text into a URL slug.

Rules:
- Lowercase.
- Remove diacritics (`é` → `e`, `ö` → `o`): normalize to NFKD and drop combining marks.
- Every run of characters that are not `a-z` or `0-9` becomes a single `-`.
- No `-` at the start or end. Nothing left → `""`.

Examples:
- `slugify("Héllo, Wörld!")` → `"hello-world"`
- `slugify("  Hello   World  ")` → `"hello-world"`
- `slugify("C++ & Rust")` → `"c-rust"`
- `slugify("")` → `""`

Add tests in `test/`.

title: Add readingTime(text, wpm)
body:
Add `src/reading.js` with a named export `readingTime(text, wpm = 200)` that returns the reading time in whole minutes. It counts words with `tokenize` from `src/tokenize.js`.

Rules:
- `minutes = Math.ceil(words / wpm)`; so 0 words → `0`, 1 word → `1`.
- `wpm` that is not a number greater than 0 → throw a `RangeError`.

Examples:
- 200 words → `1`, 201 words → `2` (default wpm)
- 250 words with `wpm = 100` → `3`
- `readingTime("hi", 0)` → throws `RangeError`

Add tests in `test/`.

title: Add the textstat CLI
body:
Add `bin/textstat.js`, run as `node bin/textstat.js <command> ...`, using the library functions.

Commands:
- `freq [--top N] <file>` — word frequencies of the file's text (`wordFreq`): one `word count` line per pair, e.g. `b 3`.
- `slug <text...>` — prints `slugify` of the arguments joined by one space, e.g. `slug Héllo Wörld` prints `hello-world`.
- `time [--wpm N] <file>` — prints the reading time of the file's text as `<minutes> min`, e.g. `3 min` (default wpm 200).

Each result ends with a newline. Exit codes:
- `0` success
- `1` no command, an unknown command, or bad arguments: print a usage message listing the three commands to stderr
- `2` the file cannot be read: print the error to stderr

Add tests in `test/` that run the CLI (e.g. with `child_process.execFileSync` / `spawnSync`).

title: Add truncate(text, max, suffix)
body:
Add `src/truncate.js` with a named export `truncate(text, max, suffix = "…")` that shortens text to at most `max` characters (UTF-16 `.length`), including the suffix.

Rules:
- `text.length <= max` → return `text` unchanged.
- Otherwise return the longest prefix that ends right before a whitespace character, with trailing whitespace trimmed, plus `suffix`, whose total length is `<= max`.
- If no such prefix exists (no whitespace early enough, or it would be empty), cut hard: the first `max - suffix.length` characters plus `suffix`.
- `max < suffix.length` → throw a `RangeError`.

Examples:
- `truncate("hello world", 20)` → `"hello world"`
- `truncate("hello", 5)` → `"hello"`
- `truncate("the quick brown fox", 12)` → `"the quick…"`
- `truncate("hello world", 8, "...")` → `"hello..."`
- `truncate("abcdefghij", 5)` → `"abcd…"`
- `truncate("hi there", 2, "...")` → throws `RangeError`

Add tests in `test/`.
